name: Create or Destroy Water

header.Components: V, S, M (a mix of water and sand)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: a mix of water and sand

authored_intent: Choose create/destroy; open container up to 10 gallons or 30-foot cube rain/extinguishing/fog destruction; higher slots add 10 gallons or 5-foot cube edge; no arbitrary liquid creation.

rules.text: You do one of the following: Create Water.
You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container.
Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there.
You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range.
Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.
You create or destroy 10 additional gallons of water, or the size of the Cube increases by 5 feet, for each spell slot level above 1.
